Hits were prop-girth-strap-roll, prop-grip-strap-blank, prop-chape-blank, prop-leather-punch-sd1, prop-eye-punch-die, prop-punch-link-die, prop-chisel-punch-st1, prop-punch-awl-sv1, prop-netting-gauge. None of the 4 ids are taken. No openkit-belt* pack existed.
judgment_calls: Strap roll is a flat-wound 3.8 cm belt strap coil lying flat with a square-cut tail. The girth strap roll is a saddler roll and the leather wrap is a wide 24 cm cover panel on a Y-axis roll, so it does not repeat either
Buckle is a rough-cast frame with a centre bar but no tongue, plus a sprue and flash fin, so it reads as a blank and not as an inventory icon
Tip chape is a small folded flat strap-end with an open slot and an unfiled tip. The scabbard chape is a tapered hollow shell standing upright
Punch block is an end-grain stump with a strap offcut and punch scars. It is a work surface, not a punch tool
Contact-sheet eye-check pass 1 found a detached strap tail and detached sprues on the tip chape and buckle. These were moved to overlap. Pass 2 shows no floating parts
